service.name: The Weapon’s Refrain (Ultimate)
service.longDescription: Just as warriors temper their spirits in battle, so too does the wandering minstrel hone his craft through colorful retellings of heroic deeds. His rendition of your triumph over the Ultima Weapon takes the threads of history and weaves them into an epic tapestry.

rewards.title: Ultima Totem
rewards.text: Ultimate-specific totems that can be exchanged for a weapon of your choosing.

rewards.title: The Ultimate Legend
rewards.text: Exclusive title acquired from completing the duty.

rewards.title: Ultimate Achievement
rewards.text: Achievement unlocked upon defeating The Ultima Weapon in The Weapon's Refrain.
